page.overview:
Who is Ashantir Lightweaver?

Ashantir Lightweaver was a Loremaster of Hoeth who committed suicide by leaping to his death from atop the White Tower. It was later revealed by the Swordmasters' investigation that the rune of Nethu was carved into the Loremaster's bed. To this day, it remains a mystery as to whom had carved said-rune, the Swordmasters having spent nearly an entire year searching for the culprits to no avail.
